caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a vintage portable stove or brazier. The main body is a rust-brown metal bucket with a wide, open top, slightly tapering towards the base. Around the upper inner rim of the bucket, there are multiple circular perforations evenly spaced. Inside, there is a metal ring structure with several smaller circular supports attached around it, all sharing the same rusty brown color with hints of reddish and dark tones. The bucket is fitted with a thin, curved metal handle attached at opposite sides on the rim. The bucket stands on a hexagonal base that is wider than the bucket itself. Text is engraved on the base, reading "L & B S Co No. 4 Phila." The background is plain and cream-colored, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Charcoal Stove
